note: The four partner types, in the order the switcher shows them. Each answers the six questions in order: what you sell, who buys it, how you earn, groups and months, why you can trust it, how to hold dates. The default is the first.

partners.label: Tour operator or DMC
partners.sell: A 3-night River or Ridge tier for couples and friend pairs already heading to Dalhousie.
partners.buyer: Guests from Delhi NCR, Chandigarh and Punjab who want one base and one thing no one else did.
partners.earn: A net rate from us, your own markup on top.
partners.groupText: Up to 12 guests on the ridge, March to November. The river base's room count is not confirmed, so ask us before you quote a group.
partners.trust: Every bookable stay is registered under the Himachal Pradesh Home Stay Rules 2025, with a named contact on call and a written emergency plan.

partners.label: Experiential travel company
partners.sell: The 6-night river-to-ridge journey, built round two sessions with the same teacher.
partners.buyer: Guests who book for the craft, the kitchen or the plants, Indian and international.
partners.earn: A net rate from us, your own markup on top.
partners.groupText: 2 to 8 guests, March to November. One paid session a day on a light pace, two on an immersive one.
partners.trust: Hosts set their own session price, and no session is listed before the host has agreed to it in writing.

partners.label: Institution or CSR team
partners.sell: A 6-night programme at one base, with the free afternoons given to a field project the village agrees to.
partners.buyer: Universities, foundations and CSR teams working on rural livelihoods in Himachal.
partners.earn: A programme fee you set on top of our net rate.
partners.groupText: Capped at the rooms available, which is 12 on the ridge today. September to November suits a study group.
partners.trust: NotOnMap has been knowledge partner to the Himalay Unnati Mission for three years, across a 13-panchayat pilot with the District Development Officer.

partners.label: Hotel or driver
partners.sell: A day out of Khajjiar for guests already with you, and a night when they want to stay.
partners.buyer: Your own guests, on the day they find Khajjiar full.
partners.earn: A referral fee per guest, paid after the stay.
partners.groupText: 2 to 8 guests at a day's notice, March to November.
partners.trust: One booking sheet, one contact, and the driver roster is agreed with you.
